test_split_first_rows_job_runner: test the SplitFirstRowsJobRunner to compute first rows of a dataset split from parquet files
test_first_rows_streaming: test the SplitFirstRowsJobRunner to compute first rows using the streaming approach when parquet metadata is unavailable
test_first_rows_with_libviewer: test the SplitFirstRowsJobRunner with libviewer Dataset to read parquet files from a local filesystem
test_first_rows_column_name_length: test the SplitFirstRowsJobRunner raises TooLongColumnNameError when column names exceed the configured maximum length
test_first_rows_auth_scenarios: test the SplitFirstRowsJobRunner with public, gated, and private datasets to verify token-based access control
